chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims ascending to Jerusalem.
chapter.v:
When the
Lord brought back his exiles to Jerusalem,it was like a dream!

We were
filled with laughter,and we sang for joy.And the other nations said,“What amazing things the Lord has done for them.”

Yes, the
Lord has done amazing things for us!What joy!

Restore our
fortunes, Lord,as streams renew the desert.

Those who
plant in tearswill harvest with shouts of joy.

They weep
as they go to plant their seed,but they sing as they return with the harvest.
